faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How much do your services cost?
faq.a1: It depends on how complex your return is. I quote the price after a short consultation — before any work begins, with no hidden fees.
faq.a2: Yes. A video consultation, online document exchange and an e-signature — no visit needed.
faq.a3: Usually April 15. You can file an extension until October 15, but any tax owed is still due by the April deadline.
faq.q4: How fast will I get my refund?
faq.a4: After e-filing, the IRS usually issues refunds within 21 days, unless the return needs extra review.
faq.q5: Do you work with clients outside Chicago?
faq.a5: Yes, online across all of Illinois. In-person meetings are in Chicago by appointment.

calculator.title: How much could you get back?
calculator.lead: A rough estimate of your federal and Illinois tax in a minute. Enter your income, filing status and number of children.
calculator.disclaimer: Not tax advice and not a tax return. It only accounts for wages (W-2), the standard deduction, the Child Tax Credit and the Earned Income Credit. Your actual amount depends on your situation — I'll calculate it precisely in a consultation.
calculator.headWarn: Head of household usually requires a child or other dependent.
calculator.incomeHint: Wages for the year (W-2). For couples — combined.
calculator.withheldHint: Optional. Add it to see your refund.
calculator.resultHint: Add the tax withheld to see your refund.

about.title: Hi, I'm Andriy
about.lead: A tax preparer with an EFIN in Chicago. I help people and businesses file their returns correctly and without stress.
about.p1: I prepare personal and business tax returns — from Form 1040 to LLCs and corporations.
about.p2: Most of my clients came through recommendations from friends and family. To me, that's the best measure of my work — and the reason I treat every return personally.
about.p3: My goal is for you not just to sign your return, but to understand it: where the numbers come from, which benefits were applied and what to do differently next year.
about.p4: Outside of taxes, I'm a photographer and videographer. That's where my love of detail, precision and clean results comes from.
about.f1Text: Meetings by appointment. I send the address once your booking is confirmed.
about.f2Text: The whole process without any travel, from anywhere in the state.
about.v1Text: I handle your return myself, start to finish.
about.v2Text: You get the price before work begins. I explain every step.
about.v3Text: Your data is used only for your return.
about.v4Text: I remind you of deadlines and file without delay.
